apiMessages.content: I want to double my training volume starting next week. Set it up.

Hold on. Doubling volume in one jump is how you get hurt or stall — not how you get strong fast. Standard safe progression is ~10%/week.

Also "double volume" is ambiguous — two ways:
- **More sessions**: 3 → 6 days/week
- **More work per session**: double the sets

Which do you mean? And I'd push you toward a 2–3 week ramp instead of a single jump. Tell me your call and I'll build it.
